description: This file defines Java DTO (Data Transfer Object) classes related to 'Action' entities, including request and response models used for API operations.

classes.name: ActionCreateRequest
classes.description: A record representing data required to create a new Action, including description, owner, and due date.

classes.name: ActionUpdateRequest
classes.description: A record representing data used to update an existing Action, including description, owner, due date, and status.

classes.name: ActionResponse
classes.description: A record representing the data returned in response to Action operations, including IDs, description, owner, due date, status, and timestamps.
